say:0:1660201001:2.text: "I sing with the breeze, and the morning dew dances to my tune."
say:0:1660201001:2.source_cn: “我在柔风中轻唱，伴着晨露叮当。”

say:1:1660201002:1.text: "The wind brushes tender buds awake... Do you smell it? That shy scent of spring?"
say:1:1660201002:1.source_cn: “风拂过含苞的嫩蕾，幽微啊，是早春的芬芳。”

say:2:1660201003:1.text: "Easy there, traveler. Don't rush it. Let spring arrive in her own time."
say:2:1660201003:1.source_cn: “行人啊，你莫要心急。且待春光，且待春光。”
say:2:1660201003:1.male: "Easy there, traveler. Don't rush it. Let spring arrive in her own time."
say:2:1660201003:1.female: "Easy there, traveler. Don't rush it. Let spring arrive in her own time."

say:3:1660201004:1.text: "When the valley is crowned with blossoms, then, and only then, shall we dress the goddess' temple!"
say:3:1660201004:1.source_cn: “待花开满山谷，再去点缀女神的圣堂！”

say:7:1660201007:0.text: Chippy's fine, just... why is it suddenly winter again?
say:7:1660201007:0.source_cn: 没、没事。奇怪，这天气怎么像冬天一样冷？

say:8:1660201008:0.text: Right? It was warm just a while ago!
say:8:1660201008:0.source_cn: 是啊，之前明明很暖和的。

say:9:1660201009:0.text: Let's just grab the flowers and skedaddle... Ow! That one bit Chippy!
say:9:1660201009:0.source_cn: 我们摘了花就赶紧回去吧。哎呀，好痛！

say:10:1660201010:1.text: That rose isn't even open yet! You rushed her, and she poked you for it.
say:10:1660201010:1.source_cn: 那朵蔷薇还没开呢，你太心急啦。

say:11:1660201011:1.text: But it smells sooo good already! Chippy wants to put it in the Magister's study. It'll make the whole room happier!
say:11:1660201011:1.source_cn: 可是，它闻起来这么香，满满想把它放在主人的书房里。

say:12:1660201012:1.text: He's been stuck inside all day. Poor Magister...
say:12:1660201012:1.source_cn: 主人只能闷在屋里处理公事，也太可怜了。
say:12:1660201012:1.male: He's been stuck inside all day. Poor Magister...
say:12:1660201012:1.female: She's been stuck inside all day. Poor Magister...

choice_prompt:13:1660201012.text: He's been stuck inside all day. Poor Magister...
choice_prompt:13:1660201012.source_cn: 主人只能闷在屋里处理公事，也太可怜了。
choice_prompt:13:1660201012.male: He's been stuck inside all day. Poor Magister...
choice_prompt:13:1660201012.female: She's been stuck inside all day. Poor Magister...

say:14:1660201013:1.text: Whoa, Magister, you're done with work already?
say:14:1660201013:1.source_cn: 哇，主人，您已经忙完了吗？
say:14:1660201013:1.male: Whoa, Magister, you're done with work already?
say:14:1660201013:1.female: Whoa, Magister, you're done with work already?

say:16:1660201014:1.text: But last night you were groaning about "too much work to do"...
say:16:1660201014:1.source_cn: 可是昨天晚上，主人还在大喊事情好多……
say:16:1660201014:1.male: But last night you were groaning about "too much work to do"...

say:19:1660201017:1.text: You dramatically produce an envelope sealed with a floral wax crest.
say:19:1660201017:1.source_cn: 梅林拿出一封信件，封面上加着花朵图案的火漆。
say:19:1660201017:1.male: You dramatically produce an envelope sealed with a floral wax crest.
say:19:1660201017:1.female: You dramatically produce an envelope sealed with a floral wax crest.

say:20:1660201018:1.text: In the center, written in elegant cursive, is a single name: Ludovic.
say:20:1660201018:1.source_cn: 正中用优雅的花体字写着一个名字：柳博米尔

say:21:1660201019:1.text: Oh, it's been so long since we heard from him!

say:22:1660201020:0.text: "Dear <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it has been too long. I wonder, do you still remember those of us from Whiteridge? With Dawnlight Revelry approaching, there will be a grand performance in Cedartown. Should time permit... I hope you'll come."
say:22:1660201020:0.male: "Dear <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it has been too long. I wonder, do you still remember those of us from Whiteridge? With Dawnlight Revelry approaching, there will be a grand performance in Cedartown. Should time permit... I hope you'll come."

say:23:1660201021:1.text: Oh right, Dawnlight Revelry's coming up... Ludovic really knows how to dance around a point. He misses you—that's what he's not saying!
say:23:1660201021:1.source_cn: 对哦，马上就是晨辉节了。梅林，柳博米尔写信还真是含蓄呢...
say:23:1660201021:1.male: Oh right, Dawnlight Revelry's coming up... Ludovic really knows how to dance around a point. He misses you—that's what he's not saying!
say:23:1660201021:1.female: Oh right, Dawnlight Revelry's coming up... Ludovic really knows how to dance around a point. He misses you—that's what he's not saying!

say:24:1660201022:1.text: Now that Chippy thinks about it... it really has been a while since we saw anyone from Whiteridge. And there's a play! A "grand" one at that! Chippy wants front row seats! Can we go, Magister? Pleeeease?
say:24:1660201022:1.source_cn: 这么一想，我们真的很久没见到白山的朋友们了，而且雪松镇...

say:25:1660201023:1.text: But... Merlin still has unfinished work.
say:25:1660201023:1.source_cn: 可是，今日事，今日毕。梅林的公务还没有做完哦。

say:27:1660201024:1.text: ... Alright, alright. There's no stopping you two.
say:27:1660201024:1.male: ... Alright, alright. There's no stopping you two.
say:27:1660201024:1.female: ... Alright, alright. There's no stopping you two.

choice:26:0:1.text: Work can wait. Friends are more important!
choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 比起那些杂事，还是去见老朋友更重要！
choice:26:0:1.male: Work can wait. Friends are more important!
choice:26:0:1.female: Work can wait. Friends are more important!

choice:17:0:1.text: That was last night. Today I have business elsewhere!
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 昨晚是昨晚，今天我另有要事！
choice:17:0:1.male: That was last night. Today I have business elsewhere!
choice:17:0:1.female: That was last night. Today I have business elsewhere!

choice:31:0:1.text: No! I just have a bigger priority!
choice:31:0:1.male: No! I just have a bigger priority!
choice:31:0:1.female: No! I just have a bigger priority!

choice:15:1:2.text: No, but I'm officially done caring!
choice:15:1:2.male: No, but I'm officially done caring!
choice:15:1:2.female: No, but I'm officially done caring!

choice:13:1:2.text: Yeah. Look at all this spring glory! We should all go out!
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 对啊，满目春景，就出去走走！
choice:13:1:2.male: Yeah. Look at all this spring glory! We should all go out!
choice:13:1:2.female: Yeah. Look at all this spring glory! We should all go out!
